description:
Cast Chain of Plasma by paying {1}{R}, targeting Brash Taunter.
Ashling triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw a card.
Resolve Chain of Plasma, dealing 3 damage to Brash Taunter and choosing to discard a card to copy it.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2 (getting Ashling's additional results once each).
